Project Coordinator

Mountain View, CA 94040

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Bidding Process Coordination

Prepare and distribute invitations to bid
Manage document distribution in compliance with standard company procedures
Coordinate communication between the architect, client, project manager, and subcontractors throughout the bidding process
Collect, track, and organize incoming vendor and subcontractor proposals

Coordinate basic project information, subcontracts, and compliance documentation throughout the project lifecycle

Collaborate seamlessly with office staff, field staff, accounting departments, architects, engineers, and clients

jobs.description:
The Health Affairs Institute at West Virginia University is currently accepting applications for a (Hybrid) Health Data Analyst.

About The Opportunity

The Health Affairs Institute (HAI) frequently engages in collaborative efforts with West Virginia’s Department of Human Services (DoHS), other state agencies, hospital systems, and nonprofits throughout West Virginia. Ideal candidates will have work experience that aligns with the mission of DoHS’s Bureau for Medical Services, Bureau for Children and Families, Bureau for Behavioral Health, Bureau for Children and Families, and Bureau for Public Health.

The Health Data Analyst’s overarching responsibilities include conducting relevant policy and evaluation research and participating in interdisciplinary research and evaluation teams. The successful Health Data Analyst will be data-driven with strong analytical skills and a proven record of finding insights in disparate data and effectively communicating that information to drive decision-making.

Benefits

We strongly believe in work-life balance and keeping time for things we love outside our work. WVU offers generous benefits, including:

37.5-hour work week
13 paid holidays (staff holiday calendar)
24 annual leave (vacation) days per year (employee leave)
18 sick days per year (for when you’re ill, for when you need time to care for sick family, for your own, or your family’s, regularly scheduled medical appointments. Who is family for the purpose of this leave? A lot of people in your life including immediate relatives and in-laws as well as others considered to be members of your household living under the same roof)
WVU offers a range of health insurance and other benefits
401(a) retirement savings with 6% employee contribution match, eligibility to continue health insurance, and other retiree perks. Looking for more retirement benefits information? Check out retirement health insurance benefits, retirement income, and FAQ’s.
Wellness programs

What You'll Do

Serves as an HAI representative and liaison to the West Virginia DoHS for the planning and performance of projects, programs, and activities involving health data analytics and program evaluation.
Facilitates communication and efficient collaboration between research partners at the Health Affairs Institute and the West Virginia Department of Health and Human Resources staff.
Ensures that data analytic and research/evaluation activities comply with Health Affairs Institute and University-level policies for the responsible conduct of research and federal and state policies.
Support HAI projects in communicating data and spatial analyses to many audiences Collaborate with HAI projects to execute both basic and complex data and mapping analyses. Prepare static and interactive maps and dashboards for internal & external audiences
Use statistical software (e.g., SAS Python, SQL Server) to clean, manage, and analyze data.
Use ARC or other GIS packages
Provides consultation to faculty and government partners regarding the preparation of research proposals, design and methodology, data analytics, and interpretation of results.
Identifies opportunities for potential collaborations between the Health Sciences Center and the West Virginia Department of Health and Human Resources.
Prepares reports as required by the University, the Health Sciences Center administration, and external agencies.
Communicates results of analytic projects and program evaluations with relevant West Virginia Department of Health and Human Resources staff.
Conducts or directs special projects as assigned. Acts in other matters and capacities as delegated by the Director of Health Analytics for the Health Affairs Institute.
Conducts advanced analytics such as machine learning and performs predictive analytics
Possesses knowledge and expertise in geo-spatial analysis

Master’s Degree in a health-related field
A minimum of two (2) years of experience in the following:
Record of research and achievement in health outcomes and policy research (health services research, public health informatics, health policy, clinical outcomes) as evidenced by publications and a sustained research program.
Experience and knowledge in machine learning and predictive analytics
Experience in conducting geo-spatial analysis
Experience conducting research/evaluation within the academic and governmental sectors.
Good knowledge of Medicaid Claims data and adequate understanding of using eligibility, facility header, facility detail, and professional files.
Experience in conducting in-house training

Any equivalent combination of related education and/or experience will be considered.
All qualifications must be met by the time of employment.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Extensive knowledge and experience in utilizing large health databases for research, program evaluation, and policy development.
Ability to project and maintain a positive and collaborative attitude. Record of accomplishments in the area of health data analytics.
Strong ability to communicate goals, methods, and results of research initiatives with key stakeholders. Demonstrated proficiency in the use of standard software packages such as SAS or R
Experience with Python, SQL Server, R, PowerBI, Geocoding, Tableau, ARC
Good knowledge of handling mortality data
Experience working with Medicaid Claims data and adequate understanding of using eligibility, facility header, facility detail, and professional files.
Training and facilitation skills
Strong understanding of Data Security and Compliance – particularly with HIPAA and PHI data access and storage

Requirements

Valid driver's license

About WVU

West Virginia University is a place of purpose and community. We take pride in our profound impact on the state of West Virginia and are committed to the personal and professional growth of our employees.

From the groundbreaking R1 research at our flagship campus in Morgantown to the career-oriented programs at WVU Potomac State in Keyser, and the technology-intensive programs at WVU Tech in Beckley, the contributions of WVU employees resonate across the state, touching lives and shaping futures.

At WVU, you will discover a supportive community that champions work-life balance and fosters a collaborative atmosphere. Our core values — service, curiosity, respect, accountability and appreciation — unite us as Mountaineers.

Join us at West Virginia University, where your work will make a lasting impact. To learn more about WVU, visit wvu.edu.

Working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work flexibility, learning, and career development. You’ll add to your technical credentials and certifications while enjoying a generous, flexible vacation policy and educational assistance. We also have comprehensive leadership and technical development academies to help build your skills and capabilities.

Summary

The Business Intelligence Business Analyst focuses on building and maintaining scalable data solutions that empower teams with reliable insights. It blends analytics, data engineering, dashboard development, and cross‑functional collaboration. The role requires both technical depth and the ability to translate business needs into actionable data products.

Your role in our mission

Collaborate with team members and stakeholders to define key business metrics and gather requirements for which insights should be made available at scale.
Architect data pipelines, design, and build new dashboards for stakeholders to address their needs.
Maintain and improve existing data infrastructure and dashboards based on evolving business requirements.
Publish and maintain clear documentation to inform and educate users at scale, gather feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
Identify ways to streamline and improve the efficiency of our data.

Lead projects end-to-end, see around corners, and provide thought partnership to your team.

Experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool (Cognos, Tableau, Power BI, Power Automate etc.).
Experience in querying and analyzing and working with data languages and platforms to investigate large and diverse data sets.

Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers, listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies, and featured as an Innovation and Disruption leader by CBS News. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Engineer the Workflows Behind Mission-Critical Deliveries

Airspace delivers service levels that no team could achieve on manual effort alone. Our platform is what makes that possible — a mature, deeply capable system that encodes exactly how, when, and under what conditions every order activity should happen. The more faithfully that technology reflects the real-world needs of each customer, the more our people are freed to do what they do best: execute flawlessly when failure is not an option.

We're looking for a Solutions Engineer
to join our R&D team and own that translation layer between the customer and the platform. You'll take complex, real-world customer Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and turn them into precise, custom workflows inside our core system — software defined workflows that govern the rules and timing of every order activity. You'll also configure the mobile workflows our drivers follow in the field, ensuring that every customer-specified action is performed correctly, every time.

This is a role for someone who finds deep satisfaction in taking something ambiguous and complicated and making it exact.

What You'll Do

Partner Across Customers and Internal Teams

Work closely with onboarding, operations, account management, and product to gather requirements, clarify ambiguity in customer SOPs, and validate that configured workflows reflect real operational intent. Serve as the bridge between what a customer says they need and how the platform delivers it.

Translate Customer SOPs into Intelligent Workflows

Take detailed, often complex customer SOPs and parse them into highly accurate, custom workflows within Airspace's core platform. Build and maintain the JSON-defined workflow diagrams that specify all the business rules for a customer — including which order activities occur, when they're triggered, and under what conditions. Own the accuracy and completeness of these configurations end to end.

Configure Field & Mobile Driver Workflows

Configure the mobile workflows that guide drivers through customer-specific activities in the field. Ensure that every required step — captures, scans, confirmations, exception handling — is presented correctly and in the right sequence, so that what happens on the ground matches exactly what the customer expects.

Maintain, Test, and Evolve Configurations

Rigorously test and validate workflows before they go live, and iterate as customer requirements change over time. Catch edge cases before they become field problems, and continuously improve the reliability of the configurations you own.

Build for Scale and Reuse

Identify common patterns across customers and verticals, and design reusable workflow components and templates that reduce configuration time and increase consistency. Help shape the tooling, standards, and best practices that make workflow configuration faster and more reliable as Airspace scales.

Measure and Drive Workflow Impact

Own the metrics that prove your configurations are working as intended. Track how faithfully operations adhere to the workflows you've built — surfacing where reality diverges from the configured procedure and feeding that back into better configurations. Drive up the share of orders that run on auto-pilot, where the platform executes the right activities at the right time without manual intervention. And monitor service levels across orders governed by Task Workflows, ensuring that the precision of your configurations translates directly into reliable, on-time, mission-critical delivery. Use these signals — adherence, automation rate, and service-level performance — to continuously identify what to refine next.

Requirements

2–4+ years of experience in solutions engineering, implementation, systems configuration, business analysis, or a comparable role that bridges customer requirements and a technical platform.
A proven background taking complicated SOPs and parsing them into actionable process flow diagrams or structured workflows is highly desired.

Exceptional organization and attention to detail — you naturally bring structure to complexity and don't let edge cases slip through.
Experience governing processes that encourages adoption without proliferation
Comfort working with structured data and configuration logic (e.g., JSON, rules engines, conditional/branching logic). You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to read, reason about, and build logical rule structures confidently.
Strong communication and requirements-gathering skills, with the ability to interview stakeholders and customers to surface the real process beneath a written SOP.
Familiarity with process-mapping tools (e.g., BPMN, Lucidchart, Visio) is a plus.
Logistics, supply chain, or operations experience preferred but not required — we'll help you build domain expertise.
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Role Details

Department:
R&D

Team:
No direct reports initially; you'll collaborate closely across engineering, product, operations, onboarding, and account management. This position will likely grow into an org so manager aspirations are a plus.

Location:
Carlsbad, CA preferred. Open to remote in the US

Success Metrics

2026:
Independently own end-to-end workflow configuration for new customer onboardings; deliver accurate, on-time workflow and mobile configurations with minimal field defects. Establish plan to increase company autopilot KPIs and demonstrate ability in one sector.

2027:
Dramatic increases in autopilot metrics across all sectors.

Your First 90 Days

Build relationships across onboarding, operations, and product; develop deep fluency in Airspace's workflow engine, JSON workflow schema, and mobile configuration tools; shadow customer onboardings; and configure and ship your first customer workflow under guidance.

Your First 180 Days

Independently own workflow governance and mobile configuration for new customer onboardings, translate complex SOPs into production-ready workflows with high accuracy, and begin building reusable components and templates that improve configuration speed and consistency.

Compensation

We are One Team. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
We make an Impact. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.

We are Transparent. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
We are Innovative. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

About Airspace:

From life-saving organs to essential machinery components, Airspace is trusted by the world’s largest companies and most critical healthcare organizations to move their most time-sensitive shipments on time, every time. Our proprietary AI-powered platform is the most advanced of its kind- awarded and protected by multiple patents, it provides speed, reliability, and transparency unrivaled in time-critical logistics. We are thinkers, builders, and doers; from building and deploying AI in the world to assembling a world-class operations team, Airspace is on a hypergrowth trajectory while remaining hyper-focused on the needs of our customers and team members.

jobs.title: Volunteer and Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Stroke Awareness Oregon

Stroke Awareness Oregon (SAO) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to reducing stroke-related death and disability by educating Oregonians about stroke recognition, risk reduction, and rapid response. SAO accomplishes its mission through community presentations, healthcare trainings, public events, and the power of passionate volunteers across the area.
Position Overview

The Volunteer Coordinator is a part-time, hourly position responsible for building and sustaining SAO’s volunteer program. This role recruits, trains, schedules, and supports volunteers who deliver stroke awareness presentations, staff community events, distribute materials, and carry out a variety of operational tasks in support of SAO’s mission. The Volunteer Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for volunteers and plays a critical role in expanding SAO’s community reach.
Key Responsibilities

Volunteer Recruitment

•      Develop and implement strategies to recruit volunteers from diverse community networks, including healthcare, faith, corporate, academic, and civic sectors
•      Post volunteer opportunities on appropriate platforms (ConnectCentralOR, Idealist, SAO’s website and social media, etc.)
•      Represent SAO at volunteer fairs, community events, and partner organization meetings to cultivate interest
•      Build a strong pipeline of trained volunteers to meet ongoing and seasonal program demand
•      Respond promptly to volunteer inquiries and guide prospective volunteers through the onboarding process
Volunteer Training & Onboarding

•      Coordinate and facilitate orientation sessions for all new volunteers
•      Train volunteers to deliver SAO’s stroke awareness presentations and educational materials with accuracy and confidence
•      Maintain and update training materials, presenter guides, and educational resources in collaboration with the Executive Director
•      Ensure all active volunteers are current on SAO messaging, HIPAA and confidentiality expectations, and organizational policies
•      Track training completion records and maintain volunteer files
Scheduling – Presentations & Trainings

•      Coordinate and schedule community stroke awareness presentations and healthcare trainings across the tri-county area
•      Match volunteer presenters with assignments based on geography, availability, skill, and audience
•      Confirm logistics with hosting sites and volunteers in advance of each engagement
•      Maintain an accurate, up-to-date master calendar of all volunteer activities and presentations
•      Follow up after presentations to collect feedback, track outcomes, and support continuous improvement
Event Volunteer Coordination

•      Recruit, confirm, and schedule volunteers for SAO events including health fairs, fundraising events, awareness campaigns, and tabling opportunities
•      Develop event-specific volunteer roles, shift structures, and briefing materials
•      Serve as the point of contact for event volunteers before, during, and after each event
•      Ensure adequate volunteer coverage and a positive volunteer experience at all events
Materials Delivery & Logistics Support

•      Coordinate the delivery of stroke awareness materials, signage, and supplies to presentations, trainings, and events
•      Maintain and track SAO’s inventory of educational materials and presentation supplies
•      Arrange logistics for material pick-up, drop-off, and/or mailing as needed
•      Assist with physical delivery of materials within the local area when required
Volunteer Relations & Retention

•      Foster a welcoming, mission-centered volunteer culture that promotes engagement and long-term retention
•      Recognize and celebrate volunteer contributions through thank-you communications, recognition events, and other appreciation efforts
•      Maintain regular communication with active volunteers through newsletters, updates, and direct outreach
•      Solicit volunteer feedback and bring forward suggestions to improve the program
•      Address volunteer concerns or conflicts promptly and professionally
Data Management & Reporting

•      Maintain accurate records in SAO’s volunteer management system, including contact information, hours, training status, and assignment history
•      Track and report volunteer metrics including hours served, presentations delivered, and events staffed
•      Provide regular updates and reports to the Executive Director on volunteer program activity and outcomes

General Operational Support

•      Assist with other volunteer-related activities and organizational tasks as assigned by the Executive Director
•      Represent SAO professionally in all community and volunteer interactions
•      Support SAO’s mission and values in all aspects of the role

Qualifications

Required

•      Minimum two (2) years of experience in volunteer coordination, community outreach, program coordination, or a related field
•      Demonstrated ability to recruit, engage, and retain volunteers or community participants
•      Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills
•      Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple schedules, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously
•      Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Gmail) and/or Microsoft Office
•      Reliable transportation, valid Driver’s License and insurance and ability to travel locally for material delivery and community events
•      Ability to pass a background check
•      Self-directed and able to work independently in a small nonprofit environment
•      Commitment to SAO’s mission of stroke awareness and prevention
Preferred

•      Experience working in a nonprofit, healthcare, or public health organization
•      Familiarity with volunteer management software or CRM platforms
•      Experience coordinating educational presentations or community training programs
•      Bilingual or multilingual skills; Spanish fluency a plus
•      Knowledge of stroke, cardiovascular health, or related public health topics

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

This position operates in both office and community-based settings. Regular local travel throughout the greater tri-county area is required for events, presentations, and material deliveries. The role involves occasional lifting and transport of materials and supplies (up to 30 lbs). Flexible scheduling is available; however, some evening and weekend availability may be required to support events and presentations.

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Engineer the Workflows Behind Mission-Critical Deliveries

Airspace delivers service levels that no team could achieve on manual effort alone. Our platform is what makes that possible — a mature, deeply capable system that encodes exactly how, when, and under what conditions every order activity should happen. The more faithfully that technology reflects the real-world needs of each customer, the more our people are freed to do what they do best: execute flawlessly when failure is not an option.

We're looking for a Solutions Engineer
to join our R&D team and own that translation layer between the customer and the platform. You'll take complex, real-world customer Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and turn them into precise, custom workflows inside our core system — software defined workflows that govern the rules and timing of every order activity. You'll also configure the mobile workflows our drivers follow in the field, ensuring that every customer-specified action is performed correctly, every time.

This is a role for someone who finds deep satisfaction in taking something ambiguous and complicated and making it exact.

What You'll Do

Partner Across Customers and Internal Teams

Work closely with onboarding, operations, account management, and product to gather requirements, clarify ambiguity in customer SOPs, and validate that configured workflows reflect real operational intent. Serve as the bridge between what a customer says they need and how the platform delivers it.

Translate Customer SOPs into Intelligent Workflows

Take detailed, often complex customer SOPs and parse them into highly accurate, custom workflows within Airspace's core platform. Build and maintain the JSON-defined workflow diagrams that specify all the business rules for a customer — including which order activities occur, when they're triggered, and under what conditions. Own the accuracy and completeness of these configurations end to end.

Configure Field & Mobile Driver Workflows

Configure the mobile workflows that guide drivers through customer-specific activities in the field. Ensure that every required step — captures, scans, confirmations, exception handling — is presented correctly and in the right sequence, so that what happens on the ground matches exactly what the customer expects.

Maintain, Test, and Evolve Configurations

Rigorously test and validate workflows before they go live, and iterate as customer requirements change over time. Catch edge cases before they become field problems, and continuously improve the reliability of the configurations you own.

Build for Scale and Reuse

Identify common patterns across customers and verticals, and design reusable workflow components and templates that reduce configuration time and increase consistency. Help shape the tooling, standards, and best practices that make workflow configuration faster and more reliable as Airspace scales.

Measure and Drive Workflow Impact

Own the metrics that prove your configurations are working as intended. Track how faithfully operations adhere to the workflows you've built — surfacing where reality diverges from the configured procedure and feeding that back into better configurations. Drive up the share of orders that run on auto-pilot, where the platform executes the right activities at the right time without manual intervention. And monitor service levels across orders governed by Task Workflows, ensuring that the precision of your configurations translates directly into reliable, on-time, mission-critical delivery. Use these signals — adherence, automation rate, and service-level performance — to continuously identify what to refine next.

Requirements

2–4+ years of experience in solutions engineering, implementation, systems configuration, business analysis, or a comparable role that bridges customer requirements and a technical platform.
A proven background taking complicated SOPs and parsing them into actionable process flow diagrams or structured workflows is highly desired.

Exceptional organization and attention to detail — you naturally bring structure to complexity and don't let edge cases slip through.
Experience governing processes that encourages adoption without proliferation

Strong communication and requirements-gathering skills, with the ability to interview stakeholders and customers to surface the real process beneath a written SOP.

Logistics, supply chain, or operations experience preferred but not required — we'll help you build domain expertise.
Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

R&D

No direct reports initially; you'll collaborate closely across engineering, product, operations, onboarding, and account management. This position will likely grow into an org so manager aspirations are a plus.

Location:
Carlsbad, CA preferred. Open to remote in the US

2026:
Independently own end-to-end workflow configuration for new customer onboardings; deliver accurate, on-time workflow and mobile configurations with minimal field defects. Establish plan to increase company autopilot KPIs and demonstrate ability in one sector.

2027:
Dramatic increases in autopilot metrics across all sectors.

Build relationships across onboarding, operations, and product; develop deep fluency in Airspace's workflow engine, JSON workflow schema, and mobile configuration tools; shadow customer onboardings; and configure and ship your first customer workflow under guidance.

Your First 180 Days

Independently own workflow governance and mobile configuration for new customer onboardings, translate complex SOPs into production-ready workflows with high accuracy, and begin building reusable components and templates that improve configuration speed and consistency.

From life-saving organs to essential machinery components, Airspace is trusted by the world’s largest companies and most critical healthcare organizations to move their most time-sensitive shipments on time, every time. Our proprietary AI-powered platform is the most advanced of its kind- awarded and protected by multiple patents, it provides speed, reliability, and transparency unrivaled in time-critical logistics.
